'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Josh Mack LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Josh Mack]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough]]
* '''Username:''' Remaker
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
